sections.title: Day 13 學習概覽
sections.markdown:
今天進入 **比較級、最高級與 `as ... as`**。前面已完成時態、被動、分詞、關係子句、連接詞與條件句，因此今天 Part 5 開始刻意混合舊考點。

目前沒有收到前幾天的實際作答結果，因此維持 **860～900 分難度**。今天建議約 **90 分鐘**；Part 5 開始要求平均 **20 秒左右／題**。

sections.title: ① 今日單字｜30 個
sections.markdown:
主題：**Business Performance / Growth / Competition**

| 單字 | 中文 | TOEIC 高頻搭配 |
|---|---|---|
| performance | 表現 | improve performance |
| growth | 成長 | economic growth |
| expand | 擴張 | expand operations |
| expansion | 擴張 | business expansion |
| increase | 增加 | increase revenue |
| decrease | 減少 | decrease costs |
| decline | 下降 | sales decline |
| improve | 改善 | improve efficiency |
| improvement | 改善 | significant improvement |
| achieve | 達成 | achieve a goal |
| target | 目標 | sales target |
| objective | 目標 | business objective |
| competitive | 有競爭力的 | competitive price |
| competitor | 競爭者 | major competitor |
| advantage | 優勢 | competitive advantage |
| efficient | 有效率的 | efficient process |
| efficiency | 效率 | improve efficiency |
| productivity | 生產力 | increase productivity |
| profitable | 有利潤的 | profitable business |
| profitability | 獲利能力 | improve profitability |
| revenue | 營收 | annual revenue |
| expense | 費用 | operating expenses |
| significantly | 顯著地 | increase significantly |
| considerably | 相當地 | considerably higher |
| slightly | 稍微地 | slightly lower |
| approximately | 大約 | approximately 10 percent |
| exceed | 超過 | exceed expectations |
| outperform | 表現優於 | outperform competitors |
| comparable | 可比較的 | comparable product |
| steadily | 穩定地 | grow steadily |

今天優先記：

**competitive advantage**  
**improve efficiency**  
**increase productivity**  
**operating expenses**  
**exceed expectations**  
**outperform competitors**  
**significant improvement**  
**grow steadily**

注意：

> sales **increased significantly**

`significantly` 修飾 increased。

但：

> a **significant increase**

需要形容詞 `significant`。

---

sections.title: ② 今日文法｜比較級
sections.markdown:
基本結構：

> A is **larger than** B.

短形容詞：

> high → higher  
> low → lower  
> fast → faster

較長形容詞：

> efficient → more efficient  
> convenient → more convenient  
> competitive → more competitive

例如：

> The new system is **more efficient than** the old one.

---

sections.title: ③ TOEIC 高頻陷阱：much / far / significantly
sections.markdown:
比較級前面可以用：

> **much**  
> **far**  
> **significantly**  
> **considerably**  
> **slightly**

例如：

> Sales were **significantly higher** this quarter.

> The new machine is **far more efficient**.

> Operating expenses were **slightly lower** than expected.

但是不能：

> very higher ❌

`very` 通常修飾原級：

> very high

比較級要：

> much higher

---

sections.title: ④ 最高級
sections.markdown:
三個以上比較：

> the highest  
> the lowest  
> the largest  
> the most efficient

例如：

> This was the company's **most profitable** quarter.

注意：

最高級通常有：

> **the**

例如：

> one of **the largest** companies

TOEIC 超高頻：

> **one of the + 最高級 + 複數名詞**

例如：

> one of the **largest manufacturers**

不是：

> one of the largest manufacturer ❌

---

sections.title: ⑤ as ... as
sections.markdown:
表示：

**和……一樣**

> The new model is **as reliable as** the previous one.

結構：

> **as + 原級 + as**

不是：

> as more reliable as ❌

否定：

> The new model is **not as expensive as** the old one.

= 新款沒有舊款那麼貴。

---

sections.title: ⑥ another 高頻結構
sections.markdown:
> twice as large as

= 兩倍大。

> three times as expensive as

= 三倍貴。

例如：

> The new warehouse is **twice as large as** the old facility.

TOEIC Part 7 圖表、數字題很常看到。

---

sections.title: ⑦ Part 5 比較級陷阱
sections.markdown:
### Q1

> The new software is considerably _____ than the previous version.

(A) efficient  
(B) efficiency  
(C) more efficient  
(D) most efficient

看到：

> than

優先想到比較級。

答案：

**C**

---

### Q2

> This has been one of the _____ successful campaigns in company history.

(A) more  
(B) most  
(C) much  
(D) very

看到：

> one of the

直接警覺：

> **one of the most + adjective + plural noun**

答案：

**B**

---

### Q3

> Production costs are not as _____ as they were last year.

(A) high  
(B) higher  
(C) highest  
(D) highly

`as ... as`

中間：

**原級**

答案：

**A**

---

sections.title: ⑧ Listening｜Part 2
sections.markdown:
今天進入更多「比較／選擇」情境。

### Q1

> Which supplier offers the lower price?

(A) I haven't compared the quotations yet.  
(B) About five hundred units.  
(C) The order arrived yesterday.

**答案：A**

---

### Q2

> Isn't the new office larger than the old one?

(A) Yes, but the rent is considerably higher.  
(B) On the fifth floor.  
(C) About twenty employees.

**答案：A**

---

### Q3

> Which advertising campaign performed best?

(A) The online campaign generated the most sales.  
(B) About three weeks ago.  
(C) The marketing director.

**答案：A**

---

### Q4

> Should we choose the less expensive model?

(A) How does its warranty compare?  
(B) About $300.  
(C) At the electronics store.

**答案：A**

這是高分 Part 2 很重要的模式：

> 問「要不要選便宜的？」

回答：

> 「那保固呢？」

沒有直接 Yes / No，但非常自然。

---

### Q5

> Why were sales higher this quarter?

(A) Our new product performed better than expected.  
(B) Approximately $2 million.  
(C) In the annual report.

**答案：A**

---

### Q6

> Has productivity improved since we installed the new equipment?

(A) By nearly fifteen percent.  
(B) About three machines.  
(C) Last November.

**答案：A**

注意：

`By nearly fifteen percent.`

雖然不是 Yes，但已經表示：

**有，而且提高約 15%。**

---

sections.title: ⑨ Reading｜Part 7
sections.markdown:
限時 **3 分鐘 30 秒**。

> **QUARTERLY SALES REPORT**
>
> Horizon Electronics reported stronger-than-expected results for the third quarter. Total sales increased by 18 percent compared with the same period last year, while operating expenses rose by only 6 percent.
>
> The company's newest wireless speaker, the H-200, performed particularly well. Sales of the H-200 were approximately 30 percent higher than those of the company's previous model during its first three months on the market.
>
> Online sales also continued to grow steadily and now account for 42 percent of total revenue, compared with 35 percent one year ago.
>
> According to Sales Director Maria Chen, the company plans to increase its online advertising budget next quarter because digital campaigns have been considerably more effective than traditional newspaper advertisements.
>
> Despite the strong results, the company does not plan to increase product prices this year.

### Q1

How much did total sales increase?

(A) 6 percent  
(B) 18 percent  
(C) 30 percent  
(D) 42 percent

### Q2

What is indicated about operating expenses?

(A) They decreased  
(B) They increased more than sales  
(C) They increased by 6 percent  
(D) They remained unchanged

### Q3

How did the H-200 perform compared with the previous model?

(A) Its sales were approximately 30 percent higher  
(B) Its price was 30 percent lower  
(C) It generated 42 percent of revenue  
(D) It had lower advertising costs

### Q4

What percentage of revenue currently comes from online sales?

(A) 18 percent  
(B) 30 percent  
(C) 35 percent  
(D) 42 percent

### Q5

Why will the online advertising budget probably increase?

(A) Newspaper advertising has become more expensive  
(B) Digital advertising has been more effective  
(C) Product prices will increase  
(D) Online sales have decreased

### Q6

What does the company NOT plan to do?

(A) Increase online advertising  
(B) Continue digital campaigns  
(C) Raise product prices  
(D) Sell the H-200

**答案：1B / 2C / 3A / 4D / 5B / 6C**

注意文章：

> stronger-than-expected

就是：

**比預期更強。**

以及：

> considerably more effective than

`considerably` 強化比較級。

---

sections.title: ⑫ 今日解析
sections.markdown:
Q1：

> significantly _____ than

`than` → 比較級。

所以：

> significantly **larger than**

---

Q2：

> one of the _____ profitable branches

固定結構：

> **one of the most + adjective + plural noun**

因此：

> one of the most profitable branches

---

Q3：

> operates

要修飾動詞，所以需要：

**副詞**

又有：

> than

因此：

> **more efficiently**

這題一次考：

**詞性 + 比較級**

---

Q4：

> not as _____ as

固定：

> **as + 原級 + as**

所以：

> as expensive as

---

Q5 是今天最值得記住的陷阱：

> twice as _____ as

中間也是：

**原級**

所以：

> twice as **large** as

不是：

> twice as larger as ❌

---

sections.title: ⑬ 錯題複習｜Day 10～12
sections.markdown:
現在快速完成，不要重新讀教材。

> The hotel _____ we stayed...

**where**

> The hotel _____ we booked...

**which**

> _____ the bad weather, the flight departed.

**Despite**

> _____ the weather was bad, the flight departed.

**Although**

> Please wait until the manager _____.

**returns**

不是 `will return`。

> We will ship the order once payment _____.

**is received**

> If demand _____, production will increase.

**increases**

如果這七題可以在 **40 秒內**完成，表示第二週文法開始建立自動化。

---

sections.title: ⑭ 今日作業
sections.markdown:
今天先把單字當「搭配」複習：

> competitive advantage  
> improve efficiency  
> increase productivity  
> operating expenses  
> exceed expectations  
> outperform competitors  
> significant improvement  
> grow steadily

接著朗讀以下六句各 **3 次**：

> The new office is **much larger than** the old one.

> The new system is **far more efficient than** the previous one.

> Sales were **significantly higher than** expected.

> This is **the most profitable** branch.

> The new model is **as reliable as** the old one.

> The new warehouse is **twice as large as** the previous facility.

最後睡前重新做 Day 13 小考，第二次限制：

**2 分鐘。**

目標：

**10/10。**

如果今天第一次達到 **9～10/10 且 ≤2:45**，下一階段會增加 900 分程度的混合 Part 5 題；若 Q1～Q5 錯兩題以上，後續會繼續穿插比較級結構，不延誤整體 90 天進度。

今天只需要牢牢記住四個反射：

> **than → 比較級**

> **much / far / significantly + 比較級**

> **the + 最高級**

> **as + 原級 + as**

**Day 14** 會是第二週週測，將整合 **分詞、關係代名詞、where/when、連接詞/介系詞、時間與條件副詞子句、比較級/最高級**，並加入更接近正式 TOEIC 的 Part 5 + Part 7 混合測驗。

questions.explanation: considerably 與 than 提示使用比較級 larger。

questions.explanation: much 可以強化比較級 higher。

questions.explanation: far more efficient 是強化比較級的正確結構。

questions.explanation: one of the most + adjective + 複數名詞是固定結構。

questions.prompt: The new printer is not as _____ as the older model.
questions.explanation: not as + 原級 + as，因此使用 expensive。

questions.explanation: slightly 與 than 提示使用比較級 lower。

questions.explanation: twice as + 原級 + as，因此使用 large。

questions.explanation: 三個提案中比較，使用最高級 most detailed。

questions.explanation: significantly 與 than 提示使用比較級 higher。

questions.explanation: 修飾 operates 需要副詞，且有 than，因此使用 more efficiently。

questions.explanation: of all our locations 表示最高級，使用 highest。

questions.explanation: as + 原級 + as，因此使用形容詞 reliable。

questions.explanation: significantly 與 than 提示使用比較級 larger。

questions.explanation: one of the most + adjective + 複數名詞是固定結構。

options.A: I haven't reviewed both quotations yet.

questions.explanation: outperform 表示表現優於另一個對象。

keyTakeaway: than → 比較級；much / far / significantly + 比較級；the + 最高級；as + 原級 + as。
